n26.name: N26 (Number26)

entry.quote: Earlybird, Redalpine, einige Business Angel und Axel Springer Plug and Play investieren 2 Millionen Euro in das Girokonto-Start-up Number26.
entry.entry_asserted: The June 2014 EUR 2M round is the company's first institutional round; TechCrunch (2014-10-20) says the team 'has raised $2.6 million so far (EUR 2 million) from Earlybird Venture Capital, Redalpine Venture Partners, Axel Springer Plug and Play', and TechCrunch (2015-04-16) calls Earlybird and Redalpine 'existing investors' in the Series A. The word Seed is Wikipedia's ('EUR 2 million in seed funding in June 2014') and the Gruenderszene headline of 2014-06-19 ('Mit zwei Seed-Millionen...', page now 410 Gone); the cited deutsche-startups item names Earlybird and the amount but not the word.

graduation.quote: just raised a $10.6 million Series A round (€10 million) from Peter Thiel’s Valar Ventures, with Daniel S. Aegerter and existing investors Earlybird and Redalpine

n26.status_detail: Still private and independent (N26 AG, Berlin). Co-CEO Valentin Stalf stepped down Aug 2025, Maximilian Tayenthal left operations 31 Dec 2025, Mike Dargan CEO from April 2026 (Wikipedia). FY2025 results reported June 2026: revenue above EUR 500M and first full-year net profit.

valuation.basis: Last priced round: USD 900M Series E at a USD 9B valuation (Oct 2021). Nothing newer has closed: Allianz X sounded out a sale of its ~5% stake at a USD 3B valuation in April 2023 (FT/Reuters; N26 later said the stake was not on the market, no sale found), and Bloomberg (2025-06-05) reported N26 was 'considering a new funding round at a reduced valuation' with a partial exit for Coatue, Third Point and Dragoneer; no close of that round was found in Bing News (EN and DE) through Oct 2026. Either way the row stays in 1b_plus.

n26.notes: Mobile bank with a German banking licence (founded 2013 as Papayer GmbH, renamed Number26 2014, N26 2016). Earlybird entered in the EUR 2M seed of June 2014 and followed in the Series A (2015) and Series B (2016); the firm's list label 'Pre-Seed' is wrong. The USD 9B mark is from 2021 and two reported lower marks (USD 3B offer 2023, a mooted down round 2025) never closed as priced events.

rhodecode.name: RhodeCode

entry.quote: RhodeCode has scored $3.5 million in funding from DFJ Esprit and Earlybird Venture Capital
entry.entry_asserted: The same Gigaom article (syndicated on Yahoo Finance, 2014-10-28) says 'This is actually the first major outside investment into the until-now bootstrapped company', so there was no earlier round. No source names the round (no 'Seed' or 'Series A' in Gigaom, Webrazzi or the company's releases); the RhodeCode release of 2015-08-11 calls Jason Whitmire of Earlybird the 'Lead investor'.

searched: firm: eb_pack shows no post or press release, archive lists it 2014-2020 only
bingnews: "RhodeCode" Earlybird -> only the Oct 2014 USD 3.5M round, the 2015 CEO hire and the Appenlight purchase
bingnews: "RhodeCode" "Series A" OR seed funding $3.5 million -> 0 items
techcrunch wp search RhodeCode -> no funding post

rhodecode.status_detail: RhodeCode GmbH (Berlin, HRB 147040 B) is active in the register: no liquidation or insolvency entry, new managing director Artem Dolobanko registered 28 May 2024 (co-founder Marcin Kuzminski left as MD). rhodecode.com is live and still sells the product.

valuation.basis: One USD 3.5M round on record; no priced event near USD 1B.

rhodecode.notes: Enterprise source code management (Mercurial, Git, SVN) behind the firewall; RhodeCode Inc. (Palo Alto) was the sales arm, RhodeCode GmbH Berlin the operating company. Earlybird and DFJ Esprit put in USD 3.5M in Oct 2014, the first outside money; the round is not named anywhere I could load, so the stage is null (a first institutional round of USD 3.5M). The firm dropped the company from its list after 2020 without an exit tag.

simscale.name: SimScale

entry.quote: Earlybird Venture Capital, High-Tech Gründerfonds and BayernKapital together with a consortium of Business Angels are investing in SimScale.
entry.entry_asserted: The joint press release of 19 Nov 2014 is headed 'Earlybird invests in SimScale' and says 'the first investment in SimScale was made by HTGF, BayernKapital and a Business Angel consortium at the beginning of 2013', so Nov 2014 is Earlybird's first round. The release gives no round name and no amount. It sits between the 2013 HTGF seed and the round the company itself named Series A in Dec 2015.

graduation.quote: today announced it has closed its Series A funding round, led by Union Square Ventures with support from Earlybird Venture Capital and angel investor Axel Bichara

simscale.status_detail: SimScale GmbH (Munich, HRB 201813) is active; latest capital increase registered 23 Oct 2024 (EUR 169,339). No acquisition found.

valuation.basis: Largest rounds are the EUR 27M Series C (2020) and the EUR 25M extension (2021); no valuation of USD 1B or more was ever reported.

simscale.notes: Browser-based engineering simulation (CFD, FEA, thermal), Munich. Earlybird's first money went in with the unnamed Nov 2014 round (after the 2013 HTGF seed and before the Series A the company named in Dec 2015, in which Earlybird followed), so the entry is a pre-Series A round whose name no record gives; if the judge reads it as Seed, the Dec 2015 Series A graduates it. The firm's list label 'Pre-Seed' is not supported.

taptalk.name: Taptalk (Wit Dot Media; later Tapstack)

entry.quote: Wit Dot Media hatte im vergangenen Jahr in einer Seed-Runde unter anderem Kapital vom Berliner VC Earlybird bekommen, eine Million US-Dollar soll damals zusammengekommen sein.
entry.entry_asserted: Gruenderszene (2014-06-03) dates the seed with Earlybird to 2013 ('im vergangenen Jahr') for the operating company Wit Dot Media, whose second product was Taptalk; the register shows shareholder agreements of 31 May and 30 Jul 2013. TechCrunch (2014-05-20) confirms 'a $1 million seed round from undisclosed investors'. The firm's own 'Invested: 2014' is the year of the follow-on.

graduation.quote: it raised $5m 18 months ago from A-Grade (Ashton Kutcher’s investment fund), Redpoint, Earlybird, Queens Bridge and SV Angel

taptalk.status_detail: Wit Dot Media Berlin GmbH (HRB 148618 B) went into liquidation on 20 Mar 2018 (liquidator Onno Faber) and was terminated on 5 Nov 2019. The app was rebranded Tapstack in March 2016; no acquirer found.

valuation.basis: About USD 6M raised in total; shut down.

taptalk.notes: One-tap photo and video messaging app from Wit Dot Media, started in Berlin (Factory) and moved to San Francisco, which is the HQ the firm's archived page gives; the German operating company was in Berlin. The later round is unnamed (no source calls it Series A), it counts with its amount of USD 5M; the date is TechCrunch's '18 months ago' counted back from March 2016, and the founder said in Oct 2014 he was 'in the midst of raising a new round'.

bigchaindb.name: BigchainDB (ascribe)

entry.quote: has raised US $2 million in a seed funding round from investors including Barry Silbert’s Digital Currency Group, Earlybird Venture Capital, Freelands Ventures
entry.entry_asserted: ascribe GmbH was registered in Aug 2014 and this June 2015 seed is its first announced round; the firm's own page gives 'Invested: 2015'. No earlier round with Earlybird was found.

graduation.quote: announced today it has raised a €3 million Series A investment. Earlybird Venture Capital, Anthemis Group, Digital

bigchaindb.status_detail: BigchainDB GmbH (formerly ASCRIBE GmbH, Berlin, HRB 160856 B) entered liquidation on 8 Jan 2025; liquidator Daniel Lustig, founder Bruce Pon left as managing director the same day. North Data lists it as 'BigchainDB GmbH (liq)'. No sale of the company found; the team's Ocean Protocol project is a separate foundation.

valuation.basis: USD 2M seed and EUR 3M Series A; no priced event near USD 1B.

bigchaindb.notes: ascribe GmbH (blockchain registry for digital art ownership) became BigchainDB GmbH in June 2016 (blockchain database). Seed June 2015 with Earlybird, Series A Sept 2016 with Earlybird named. The firm's page still shows it Active, but the home register has it in liquidation since Jan 2025.

bonagora.name: Bonagora

entry.quote: Earlybird has led the $3.5m series-A for Bonagora, a German online wholesale platform. Previous backers Vogel Ventures, Makers.do and business angels
entry.entry_asserted: Unquote (2015-11-27) lists the previous backers as Vogel Ventures, Makers.do, Michael Brehm and Stephan Zoll; Earlybird is not among them and is named as the new lead. The register shows the matching shareholder agreement of 2 Jul 2015 and capital increase of 23 Jul 2015, so the round closed in mid-2015 and was announced in November.

bonagora.status_detail: Insolvency proceedings over Bonagora GmbH (Berlin, HRB 155896 B) were opened by the Charlottenburg court on 8 Dec 2016 (36b IN 6527/16); liquidation entered 7 Mar 2017; the company was deleted from the register as asset-less on 14 Dec 2022. Trade press (Home Accents Today, 2017-02-22, headline only, page returns 403) reported it would cease operations at the end of February 2017. No asset sale found.

valuation.basis: USD 3.5M Series A; insolvent a year later.

bonagora.notes: B2B online wholesale marketplace for home furnishings and decor (Berlin, founded 2014, New York office late 2015). Earlybird led the USD 3.5M Series A in 2015 and the company was insolvent by Dec 2016.

cashboard.name: Cashboard

entry.quote: Earlybird, Redalpine Ventures, 500 Startups, Heilemann Ventures und Bigpoint-Gründer Heiko Hubertz sowie die Altgesellschafter Makers und ProSiebenSat.1 investieren 2 Millionen Euro in Cashboard
entry.entry_asserted: The Aug 2015 item names Makers and ProSiebenSat.1 as the only existing shareholders ('Altgesellschafter') and Earlybird among the new investors; in the Nov 2016 round Earlybird is an 'Alt-Investor'. The Aug 2015 round carries no name in any source loaded (ProSiebenSat.1 added EUR 4M of TV media on top).

rounds.amount_native: EUR 2M (plus EUR 4M TV media from ProSiebenSat.1)

graduation.quote: Cashboard hat im Rahmen einer Serie-A-Finanzierung drei Millionen Euro an Wagniskapital eingesammelt. Lead-Investor ist Digital Space Ventures

cashboard.status_detail: Cashboard GmbH (Berlin, HRB 134359 B; formerly R.I.T. Refined Investment Technologies GmbH) filed for insolvency in May 2017; proceedings opened by the Charlottenburg court on 10 May 2017 (36c IN 2469/17), liquidation entered 13 Jun 2017, company terminated 11 May 2022. Operations were discontinued and most customers moved to the robo-advisor of its partner bank Ebase (Das Investment, 2017-09-13, headline). No sale of the company found.

valuation.basis: EUR 2M and EUR 3M rounds; insolvent in 2017.

cashboard.notes: Berlin robo-advisor and online investment marketplace (a Makers company, pivoted from Refined Investment in 2014/15). Earlybird entered in the unnamed EUR 2M round of Aug 2015 and is an existing investor in the round Gruenderszene and the WSJ headline call Series A (Nov 2016). The entry round has no name on record; if the judge reads it as Seed, the Nov 2016 Series A graduates it. This is not the YC S22 company of the same name in the Y Combinator book (New York finance tooling): different company.

crossengage.name: CrossEngage

entry.quote: Die neue Finanzierungsrunde wird von Vorwerk Ventures als neuem Gesellschafter sowie dem bereits bestehenden Investor Earlybird Venture Capital angeführt.
entry.entry_asserted: NOT asserted as the first round: this is the first round in which any record names Earlybird putting money in, and the same sentence calls Earlybird an already existing investor. The seven-figure seed (closed 2015, announced 2016-01-14) names Project A Ventures, Capnamic Ventures, Heilemann Ventures and IBB, not Earlybird. Heilemann Ventures and its team were brought into Earlybird in April 2016 (deutsche-startups 2016-04-26), which is the likely source of the 'existing investor' status and of the firm's archived 'Invested: 2015'; the firm's live page now says 'Invested: 2018' and 'Series A'. No announcement of an Earlybird-fund purchase between Jan 2016 and Nov 2017 was found.

rounds.amount_native: mid seven-figure EUR, half of it venture debt

graduation.quote: Nach einer Seed- und einer Venture-Runde 2015 und 2017 hat die Marketingplattform Crossengage jetzt eine A-Runde abgeschlossen.

crossengage.status_detail: Acquired by the Dutch Spotler Group in Dec 2023 (deutsche-startups DealMonitor 2023-12-22: 'Spotler Group kauft CrossEngage', price undisclosed; it names Earlybird among the selling investors). The founders left as managing directors on 29 Dec 2023 and the company was renamed Spotler GmbH on 20 Aug 2024 (register). The firm's own page says 'In 2022, Tealium acquired CrossEngage' and 'Today, CrossEngage is known as Spotler DACH': the Tealium name and the 2022 date conflict with the register and the press and look like an error on the firm's page. CrossEngage had merged with Gpredictive in Dec 2020.

valuation.basis: Over EUR 25M raised in total; acquisition price undisclosed.

crossengage.membership_detail: Not a red flag under the brief's five classes, but the judge should know: the position starts as a Heilemann Ventures seed stake (2015/16) that came to Earlybird with the Heilemann team in April 2016; Earlybird funds are named in the Nov 2017 round (co-lead) and the Jan 2019 Series A, and held 17.9% in Feb 2020 (deutsche-startups cap table check).
crossengage.notes: Berlin customer data and cross-channel marketing platform (founded July 2015 with Project A). Rounds: seed (closed 2015, announced Jan 2016), EUR 5M 'venture round' Nov 2017 co-led by Vorwerk Ventures and Earlybird, Series A Jan 2019, sale to Spotler Group Dec 2023. Whether the row's entry is the carried 2015 seed stake (Seed, graduated by the 2019 Series A) or the Nov 2017 round (unnamed, between seed and A) is a ruling for the judge; the Project A book has the same company as a Seed entry, graduated.

inkitt-gmbh.name: Inkitt

entry.quote: The Series A is being led by Kleiner Perkins, with participation also from HV Holtzbrinck Ventures, angel investor Itai Tsiddon, Xploration Capital, Redalpine Capital, Speedinvest, and Earlybird.
entry.entry_asserted: NOT asserted as the first round: this is the first round in which any record names Earlybird, and Redalpine's own post on it lists 'existing investors Redalpine, Speedinvest and Earlybird'. The firm dates its position 'Invested: 2015' (deal team Fabian Heilemann, Christian Nagel). The 2015 round was 'Speedinvest, Frontline Ventures, Heilemann Ventures and several angel investors invested $1.1m in the company in 2015' (Unquote, 2019-08-29): Heilemann Ventures, not an Earlybird fund. Heilemann Ventures and its team were brought into Earlybird in April 2016. Earlybird is not named in the USD 3.9M pre-Series A of Sept 2017 either.

rounds.amount_native: USD 59M (valuation reported 'in the region of $390 million')

inkitt-gmbh.status_detail: Private and operating (Inkitt and the paid app Galatea). Last round: USD 37M Series C led by Khosla Ventures, Feb 2024. No acquisition or newer round found in news through Oct 2026.

valuation.basis: TechCrunch: 'this current Series C values Inkitt at around $400 million post-money'. Below USD 1B.

inkitt-gmbh.membership_detail: Not one of the brief's five classes as written (Earlybird is named in the 2019 Series A), but the origin is partner-carried: the 2015 stake was Heilemann Ventures', which came to Earlybird with the Heilemann team in April 2016 (deutsche-startups 2016-04-26: 'Die Heilemann-Brüder bringen Heilemann Ventures samt Team in den Kapitalgeber Earlybird ein'). The judge should rule whether the row enters at the carried 2015 round or at the 2019 Series A.
inkitt-gmbh.notes: Reader-driven fiction publisher (Inkitt, Galatea), founded in Berlin, 'now based in San Francisco' (TechCrunch 2024), which is the city the HV, Kleiner, Khosla and NEA books use; the firm's page says Berlin. The firm's label is Seed, 2015, but that round was Heilemann Ventures' and no record names an Earlybird fund before the Series A of Aug 2019, so the entry above is the first Earlybird-named round and graduation is null. If the judge instead accepts the carried 2015 round (USD 1.1M, unnamed) as a Seed entry, the named Series A of 2019-08 (same TechCrunch citation) graduates it.

movinga.name: Movinga

entry.quote: closed just two weeks after Movinga completed a financing round with Earlybird, Heilemann Ventures and various business angels
entry.entry_asserted: Gruenderszene (2015-10-01) calls it the first round: 'In der ersten Runde erhielt Movinga Geld etwa von den Heilemann-Brüdern und Earlybird', and says of the next round 'Der Berliner Wagniskapitalgeber ist bereits investiert'. The company was registered in June 2015; the register shows the matching capital increases of 1 and 8 Sept 2015. No source gives the round a name.

graduation.amount: USD 25M (after an unnamed EUR 6M round in Oct 2015)
graduation.quote: has picked up $25 million in Series B funding. The round is being led by Index Ventures, with participation from previous backers who include the likes of Earlybird VC

movinga.status_detail: Acquired by the British logistics platform Shift in April 2023 (City A.M. 2023-04-17; Gruenderszene reports a mid double-digit million price; the third change of owner in three years after the Struengmann family office took the majority in 2020 and Jasaarah Investment in Feb 2023). Afterwards the company failed: Movinga GmbH filed for insolvency in self-administration at the end of Jan 2024 (Gruenderszene 2024-02-01) and the register shows liquidation from 8 Apr 2024 (Movinga GmbH, Berlin, HRB 167739 B, 'liq'). If the judge wants the present state instead of the exit event, it is defunct (2024-04, https://www.northdata.com/Movinga%20GmbH,%20Berlin/Amtsgericht%20Charlottenburg%20(Berlin)%20HRB%20167739%20B).

valuation.basis: Largest round USD 25M (Series B, 2016); sold in 2023 for a reported mid double-digit million euro sum.

movinga.notes: Berlin online home-removals platform (founded 2015). Earlybird was in the very first financing round (Sept 2015, with Heilemann Ventures and angels) and in every later round through 2018. The first round has no name on record; the next rounds are EUR 6M (Oct 2015) and the named USD 25M Series B (Jan 2016). Sold to Shift in April 2023, insolvent in Jan 2024.

seerene.name: Seerene

entry.quote: has raised $5 million in seed funding and opened an office in Hong Kong, its first in Asia. The round was led by Earlybird Venture Capital
entry.entry_asserted: The company's own release is headed 'Seerene Announces $5M Seed Funding' (Marketwired, 2015-12-09) and is its first outside round after the HPI spin-out (renamed Seerene GmbH in Nov 2015); silicon.de (2017-01-24) confirms 'Earlybird hatte bereits im Dezember 2015 fünf Millionen Dollar in Seerene investiert'.

graduation.quote: has raised $14 million in a Series A round led by Lakestar Capital Partners with participation from Earlybird Venture Capital

seerene.status_detail: Operating; the company was renamed Generative AI Seerene GmbH on 15 Jan 2024 (Potsdam, HRB 22123) and registered new shareholder agreements in Jan and Oct 2024. No liquidation, insolvency or acquisition entry.

valuation.basis: USD 5M seed and USD 14M Series A; no priced event near USD 1B.

seerene.notes: Software analytics platform for managing code and development teams, a Hasso Plattner Institute spin-off (formerly Software Diagnostics). Earlybird led the USD 5M seed in Dec 2015 and followed in the USD 14M Series A led by Lakestar in Jan 2017. Matches the Lakestar book (Series A entry 2017-01, Potsdam, private).

fraugster.name: Fraugster

entry.quote: has raised $5 million in funding. Earlybird led the round, alongside existing investors Speedinvest, Seedcamp and an unnamed large Swiss family office.
entry.entry_asserted: TechCrunch lists Speedinvest, Seedcamp and the family office as the existing investors and Earlybird as the new lead; Gruenderszene (2017-01-16) adds that Speedinvest and Seedcamp 'hatten bereits in einer früheren Runde im Januar 2016' invested. The firm's 'Invested: 2016' is the close year. Neither article names the round; the next round (Nov 2018) is called Series B, which makes this one the Series A by sequence only.

fraugster.status_detail: Insolvency proceedings over Fraugster Services GmbH (Berlin, HRB 195228 B) were opened by the Charlottenburg court on 17 Jan 2023 (36f IN 80/...); liquidation entered 22 Mar 2023. deutsche-startups ticker 2023-01-18: 'Millionenschweres Anti-Fraud-Startup Fraugster ist insolvent'. No asset sale found; a 'Fraugster' wordmark was filed on 3 Aug 2026 by an owner North Data does not show. The earlier UK parent Fraugster Ltd. was terminated in Jan 2020.

valuation.basis: USD 5M and USD 14M rounds; insolvent in 2023.

fraugster.notes: German-Israeli AI payment-fraud prevention for online merchants (Berlin, founded 2014). Earlybird's first round is the USD 5M round it led in Jan 2017, unnamed on record (after a Jan 2016 round by Speedinvest and Seedcamp, before the Series B of Nov 2018 in which Earlybird followed). Status and city match the Seedcamp and Speedinvest books. If the judge treats the unnamed entry as pre-Series A, the named later round is the Series B of 2018-11 (https://techcrunch.com/2018/11/07/fraugster-b/).

instamotion.name: InstaMotion

entry.quote: den noch nicht verkündeten Einstieg von Earlybird bei Instamotion
entry.entry_asserted: deutsche-startups (2019-02-11) reports Earlybird's entry ('Einstieg') as not yet announced; the register shows a capital increase to EUR 563,148 on 2 Feb 2019, and the firm's archived portfolio page first lists the company in the Dec 2018 capture, so the round was signed around the turn of 2018/19. It was never announced and has no name or amount on record. The firm's own 'Invested: 2016' equals its 'Founded: 2016' and is not supported by any record: the Oct 2016 investor was Allianz. In the Series B of March 2021 Earlybird is an existing investor.

rounds.round: strategic investment by Allianz, amount undisclosed

instamotion.status_detail: Instamotion Retail GmbH filed for insolvency at the Munich court in May 2024 (WirtschaftsWoche 2024-05-27, after a financing round failed). In July 2024 the Czech EAG Group (Carvago) took over the insolvent platform and keeps the Instamotion brand (kfz-betrieb 2024-07-11: 'Carvago hat die insolvente Plattform Instamotion übernommen'). The old legal entity was renamed IRG Abwicklung GmbH and is in liquidation since 5 Jul 2024 (Munich HRB 220802). Insolvency followed by an asset sale; successor Carvago / EAG Group.

valuation.basis: Largest round EUR 24M (Series B, 2021); sold out of insolvency in 2024.

instamotion.notes: Online used-car retailer, Munich (registered Sept 2015 in Gruenwald, platform launched late 2016, Allianz a shareholder from 2016 to 2023). Earlybird's entry was never announced: the only record is a podcast note of Feb 2019 and the capital increase registered that month; the entry stage is therefore null and the firm's year 2016 looks wrong. A vendor profile calls a EUR 7M round of Nov 2019 the Series A (register: capital increase 14 Nov 2019), which I could not confirm in press. The Series B of March 2021 (EUR 24M) names Earlybird as existing investor.

medidate.name: MediDate (later Medical One)

entry.quote: Der frisch fusionierte Earlybird-Heilemann-Geldgeber investiert nach Informationen von deutsche-startups.de gemeinsam mit Econa, einigen Business Angels aus dem Saarbrücker21-Verbund und FJ Labs in das Berliner Start-up MediDate
entry.entry_asserted: The company's release of 2020-01-23 quotes Hendrik Brandis 'von Earlybird, die seit 2016 bei MEDICAL ONE als Investoren beteiligt sind'; the register shows the matching shareholder agreement of 31 May 2016 and capital increase of 24 Jun 2016. The deutsche-startups item gives no round name (the amount is 'reportedly' 10 million). The firm's 'Invested: 2016' agrees.

rounds.round: acquisition financing for the purchase of Medical One GmbH, amount undisclosed

medidate.status_detail: eHealth MediDate GmbH (Berlin, HRB 159029 B; trading as Medical One from Jan 2020) went into insolvency in 2020: court order of 12 Jun 2020 (Charlottenburg, 36e IN ...), liquidation entered 11 Sep 2020. In Feb 2021 the Dutch Bergman Clinics, together with Berlin's Qunomedical, took over Medical One: 'eine Klinik in Stuttgart, die Marken, Patienten sowie die Verträge mit 11 Beratungszentren' (kma Online 2021-02-18; deutsche-startups DealMonitor 2021-02-18). Insolvency followed by an asset sale; successor Bergman Clinics (with Qunomedical). Register: https://www.northdata.com/eHealth%20MediDate%20GmbH,%20Berlin/Amtsgericht%20Charlottenburg%20(Berlin)%20HRB%20159029%20B

valuation.basis: No priced event near USD 1B; insolvent in 2020.

medidate.notes: Berlin platform for plastic and aesthetic surgery (eHealth MediDate GmbH, founded 2014); bought the Munich clinic group Medical One in July 2018 with Earlybird 'als der größte hinter MediDate stehende Investor' financing it, and took its name in 2020. Earlybird's entry is the mid-2016 round, unnamed on record. The North Data hit 'MediDate GmbH, Cologne' is a different company.

tradico.name: Tradico

entry.quote: So erwarben Dieter von Holtzbrinck Ventures (DvH Ventures) und Earlybird Venture Capital eine Beteiligung an der Tradico AG. Weitere Anteile sicherte sich Speedinvest. Insgesamt summiert sich das Investment auf 2,5 Millionen EUR.
entry.entry_asserted: The company's own release of 2016-09-08 says DvH Ventures and Earlybird 'acquired a stake' and Speedinvest took 'further shares' (Speedinvest was already in); the Feb 2017 release repeats that the three 'invested a sum totaling EUR 2.5 million in the startup in September 2016'. The release names no round; the Speedinvest book labels the same round Seed from Speedinvest's own portfolio card.

rounds.amount_native: about EUR 1M (Henry Ritchotte, Hermann Hauser and others)

searched: firm: eb_pack shows no post or press release

company: prnewswire 2017-02-20 'Ritchotte Invests in Tradico' -> an unnamed further round by private investors (Crowdfund Insider headline: EUR 1 million), smaller than the entry round and not called Series A
bingnews (de): "Tradico" Earlybird -> Sept 2016 round and Feb 2017 round only
bingnews (de): "Tradico" Finetrading Finanzierung Speedinvest -> same two
register: capital increases 9 Feb 2017 and 13 Sep 2018, no announced round for 2018; liquidation 2022

tradico.status_detail: tradico AG (Ruggell, Liechtenstein, FL-0002.481.570-8) entered liquidation on 10 May 2022, liquidator Rolf Jermann. No acquirer found.

valuation.basis: EUR 2.5M and about EUR 1M rounds; liquidated.

tradico.notes: Online finetrading (working-capital finance for SMEs). The legal seat is Ruggell, Liechtenstein ('Die Tradico AG hat ihren Sitz in Ruggell'), which the Speedinvest book uses; the operating subsidiary Tradico GmbH sat in Munich, which is the city on the firm's page. Earlybird entered with DvH Ventures in the EUR 2.5M round of Sept 2016.

vitraum.name: Vitraum
vitraum.status_detail: Provisional insolvency administrator appointed by the Hamburg court on 27 Mar 2020 (67h IN 27/20); liquidation entered 4 Jun 2020 (Vitraum GmbH, Hamburg, HRB 137090, 'liq'). deutsche-startups 2020-04-01: 'Hamburger Fenster-Startup Vitraum ist insolvent'. No asset sale found.
vitraum.membership_detail: No record names an Earlybird fund in any Vitraum round. The seven-figure seed of Nov 2015 names 'Heilemann Ventures, die Beteiligungsgesellschaft der Daily Deal-Gründer Fabian und Ferry Heilemann', Rolf Schmidt-Holtz and Michael Ollmann; the 2020 insolvency report again names the Heilemann brothers, Hanse Ventures and private investors, not Earlybird. Heilemann Ventures and its team were brought into Earlybird in April 2016 (deutsche-startups 2016-04-26), and Vitraum appears on earlybird.com in the Dec 2016 capture only, with no fund tag, invested year or status, and is gone by 2018. This is a partner's previous-firm position shown on the firm's site for one year.
vitraum.notes: Hamburg online seller of windows and front doors including installation, a Hanse Ventures company (registered June 2015). Searched for an Earlybird round: Bing and Google News '"Vitraum" Earlybird' (0 items), the company's seed release, the deutsche-startups insolvency report. Entry is null because nothing shows Earlybird money; if the judge still keeps the row, the carried round is the Nov 2015 Seed and no later named round was found (capital increases 2017 to 2019 were unannounced).

everoad-by-sennder.name: Everoad (formerly Convargo; merged into sennder in June 2020)

entry.quote: The startup just raised a $19 million Series A round led by Inventure Partners and Earlybird.
entry.entry_asserted: The only earlier round is the EUR 1.5M angel round of June 2016 (Xavier Niel, Oliver Samwer, Jacques-Antoine Granjon and other individuals; TechCrunch 2016-06-19), with no Earlybird. deutsche-startups (2020-06-09): 'Everoad wurde seit 2017 von Earlybird unterstützt'. The firm's 'Invested: 2017' agrees; its list label 'Pre-Seed' is wrong.

rounds.round: sennder internal round at the merger (unnamed, 'tens of millions of dollars' from existing investors plus Earlybird)

everoad-by-sennder.status_detail: Everoad merged into sennder Technologies GmbH (Berlin), announced 9 June 2020, 'in a stock-based deal' (Reuters); it then traded as 'Everoad by sennder' and later as sennder France. French press read it as a sale ('Everoad rachetée par son concurrent allemand Sennder', Les Echos headline). No price disclosed. Acquirer sennder is private.

valuation.basis: Everoad raised EUR 17.5M in total and was merged for stock at no disclosed price. The USD 1B+ mark belongs to sennder (Series D extension, June 2021: 'at a valuation the company confirms is now over $1 billion', https://techcrunch.com/2021/06/01/freight-forwarder-sennder-raises-80m-at-a-1b-valuation/) and applies only if the judge opens a separate sennder row. A reported negotiation at about EUR 2B (Handelsblatt via Gruenderszene, 2022-12-13) is not a closed round.

everoad-by-sennder.membership_detail: For Everoad itself there is no flag: Earlybird co-led the Series A. For sennder the picture is mixed and needs a ruling. (1) The sennder shares come first from the merger: 'Im Rahmen der Fusion brachte der Berliner Risikokapitalgeber seine Beteiligung in das fusionierte Unternehmen ein' (deutsche-startups DealMonitor 2020-06-09), which alone would be sale_consideration. (2) But Earlybird also put new money into sennder at the same time: the same sentence continues that it took part 'darüber hinaus mit weiterem Kapital an sennder', and Reuters (2020-06-09) says Earlybird 'joined the latest internal funding round', a 'capital injection, running into the tens of millions of dollars' from existing venture investors. That internal round has no series name. (3) No later sennder round names Earlybird: the Series D lists (Jan 2021: Accel, Lakestar, HV Capital, Project A, Scania; June 2021 extension led by Baillie Gifford) do not, though Gruenderszene says 'Alle bisherigen Geldgeber' took part in January 2021.
everoad-by-sennder.notes: (a) Entry: Convargo's USD 19M (EUR 16M) Series A of Oct 2017, co-led by Inventure Partners and Earlybird; Convargo was renamed Everoad in 2018. (b) Merger: June 2020, stock-based, Everoad shareholders became sennder shareholders. (c) New money: yes, once, in sennder's unnamed internal round that closed with the merger in June 2020; not shown in any named sennder round. So a separate sennder row would rest on an unnamed June 2020 insider round with no amount for Earlybird; its entry stage would be null (after sennder's Series C of July 2019, before the Series D of Jan 2021) and it would be private, 1b_plus, Berlin. Focus follows the HV, Lakestar and Project A books' reading of sennder; Everoad is a digital road-freight marketplace.

shapeshift.name: ShapeShift

entry.quote: The Series A funding was led by Berlin-based Earlybird. Other new investors include Lakestar, Access Venture Partners, Pantera Capital and Blockchain Capital.
entry.entry_asserted: Reuters (2017-03-29) counts Earlybird among the new investors and names FundersClub and Digital Currency Group as the previous backers. IBTimes (same day): 'there was a seed round back in summer of 2015 which raised $1.6m', then USD 2.1M in convertible notes in Feb 2016 that convert in this Series A. Christian Nagel joined the board on 21 Apr 2017 (register).

rounds.amount_native: USD 10.4M (USD 8.3M new money plus converted notes)

shapeshift.status_detail: The exchange business was wound down in 2021. SEC administrative order of March 2024 (Release 34-99676): 'On July 14, 2021, ShapeShift announced that it was dissolving its corporate entity. ShapeShift does not currently have any revenue or full-time employees.' The company's own release of 2021-07-14 says it 'has begun dismantling its corporate structure' and handed governance to a DAO (FOX token); the product lives on as open-source software run by the DAO, which is not the company. Caveat: the Swiss shell still exists in the register (ShapeShift AG, converted to ShapeShift GmbH on 17 Dec 2024, seat Sarnen, not in liquidation; https://www.northdata.com/ShapeShift%20GmbH,%20Sarnen/CHE-367.039.468), and the firm's page still shows it as Active with Christian Nagel on the board.

valuation.basis: USD 10.4M Series A is the largest round; no valuation of USD 1B or more reported.

shapeshift.notes: Non-custodial crypto asset exchange founded 2014 by Erik Voorhees; ShapeShift AG was incorporated in Switzerland (seat Zug until Sept 2021, then Sarnen) and 'formerly operated out of Denver, Colorado' (SEC). Earlybird led the USD 10.4M Series A in March 2017 as a new investor. Status and city match the Lakestar book (defunct, Sarnen); the firm's page gives London (live) and Zug (archive).
